$comment: Routes under web/src/app/api/**/route.ts that are intentionally ABSENT from docs/api/openapi.json (the public API contract published at /api/openapi and rendered by Swagger UI at /api-docs). The check-openapi-route-sync CI gate treats every path listed here as allowlisted so it does not count as undocumented drift. A NEW route that is neither documented in openapi.json NOR listed here fails the gate — a ratchet that stops the documented-vs-actual API drift from growing silently. To add a route here, pick the category that explains WHY it is not part of the public contract. Categories are documentation only; the gate just checks each route names a defined one. If you instead make a route public, document it in openapi.json and DELETE its line here (the gate fails on an allowlist entry that is also documented, and on an entry whose route file no longer exists, to keep this list honest).

categories.admin: Admin-only endpoint behind admin auth — not part of the public API surface.
categories.webhook: Inbound provider webhook (Clerk, Stripe) — called by a third party, not by public API consumers.
categories.bridge: Internal desktop/tool bridge endpoint (Aseprite, capability discovery) — local-only integration plumbing.
categories.cron: Scheduled job endpoint invoked by the platform scheduler, not by clients.
categories.internal-ai: Internal AI generation pipeline step whose request/response shape is not a stable public contract.
categories.async-status: Async job submission/polling sub-route — coupled to the parent generator, not independently consumed.
categories.account: Authenticated user account self-service (delete, data export, profile) — gated to the signed-in owner.
categories.published-game: Dynamically-served published-game runtime endpoint keyed by {userId}/{slug} — serves game assets, not the editor API.
categories.telemetry: Client telemetry beacon (web vitals, Sentry tunnel) — write-only ingestion, no documented response.
categories.meta: Meta/introspection endpoint (the OpenAPI spec itself, capability + status probes).
categories.moderation: Content-moderation/appeal endpoint — trust-and-safety surface, not a public content API.
categories.marketplace: Marketplace seller-only operation (asset upload) gated to the seller.
categories.growth: Growth/marketing capture endpoint (waitlist, feedback) — form ingestion, not a documented API.
